description: A pile of small multicolored beads sits on a yellow bedspread, with a tape dispenser near the top right and a thin cord lying across the bed. The right hand pulls and guides the cord from the right toward the bead pile, then pinches near the cord’s end as if aligning it to thread, while the left hand hovers over and lightly picks at beads in the pile to select one; contact alternates between a right-hand object (the cord) and left-hand object (a bead), with the bed as the two-hand surface underneath.
